_meta.schema_notes: Each entry pairs an SA (FRED-hosted) identifier with an NSA (Census M3 EITS API) identifier. NSA fields use `category_code` + `data_type_code`, which are the two dimensions the Census API requires. SA uses FRED series_id. FRED rarely mirrors NSA M3 series; use the Census EITS endpoint for NSA.

required_params.time: YYYY (returns all months for that year)

gotchas.duplicate_columns: Response header contains duplicate column names; time is at index 8 (not 5). Parse by index, not by name.
gotchas.for_clause_required: Omitting for=us:* returns HTTP 400 'missing for argument'.
gotchas.empty_response: HTTP 204 with empty body means no data for that filter combo; check before JSON parse.
gotchas.year_returns_months: time=YYYY returns 12 monthly rows, not an annual aggregate.

vintage_archive.limitation: No comprehensive public NSA vintage archive for M3; pseudo-real-time backtests are SA-only on FRED-mirrored series.

_meta.nondurable_limits: MNM has no UO (unfilled orders) or related percent-change codes. Unfilled orders is durable/total only.
